_comment: The web security policy for whatever serves the dashboard, expressed independently of any
particular host. It exists because this policy was built carefully - HSTS, a strict CSP with no
unsafe-inline on the console, frame-ancestors none, an exact connect-src list - and all of it
currently lives inside firebase.json. Firebase Hosting is retired from the target architecture,
so without this file the hardening would be deleted along with the platform and quietly
rediscovered later, one incident at a time.
This is the source of truth. firebase.json still carries the same policy while Firebase Hosting
is still what serves the site, and tests/test_headers.py asserts the two agree - so they cannot
drift while both exist, and firebase.json can be deleted in phase 4 without losing anything.
Render it for a real server with: python3 tools/render-headers.py --server caddy|nginx

paths.note: The free-scan page still carries an inline <script> and inline styles, so its policy has to permit them. The source lists are otherwise exact: every origin here is one the page actually loads from.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.gstatic.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://firestore.googleapis.com https://*.googleapis.com https://*.cloudfunctions.net https://*.run.app; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'

paths.note: The operator console keeps its script and styles in separate files and uses no inline handlers, so it gets the strict policy with no 'unsafe-inline' anywhere.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.run.app https://*.cloudfunctions.net; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'
